coverageNotes: INCOMPLETE ROUND. The WebSearch budget for this turn (200 calls, shared by every agent in the workflow) was already used up. All nine searches I attempted at the start were refused and not performed: 'gym in Kisumu Kenya', 'Kisumu gym membership fitness centre contact phone', 'crossfit Kisumu', 'yoga studio Kisumu', 'gym in Kisii town Kenya', 'gym in Migori Kenya', 'gym in Homa Bay Kenya', 'gym in Siaya Bondo Kenya fitness', 'gym in Nyamira Keroka Kenya'. So the queries array is empty and no area was searched. I did not work around the limit with third-party search tools. What I did instead was open individual pages directly with WebFetch: the seed's own website links (h2o.co.ke worked; two others returned 404), and a few official hotel/university/hospital sites I tried by guessing the domain. Those guesses are a small, unsystematic sample, not research coverage. Results by site: acaciapremier.com and cialaresort.com each have a gym/health club (recorded as candidates); maseno.ac.ke has no gym mention on its home page; kisiiuniversity.ac.ke, jooust.ac.ke, gluk.ac.ke and rongovarsity.ac.ke returned HTTP 503 (possibly down or blocked, not checked further); agakhanhospitals.org/kisumu returned 404; imperialhotels.co.ke, royalseasonshotel.com, kisumuclub.co.ke and sunsetkisumu.com failed DNS lookup (my guessed domains were probably wrong, which says nothing about whether those venues exist). Seed in this region: Kisumu 8 Overture entries plus 2 OSM ones, Kisii 4, and nothing for Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori or Nyamira. Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori and Nyamira are completely unresearched, as are Kisumu estates, CrossFit, yoga and martial arts, and Kisii beyond the seed. The seed's OSM 'Jeff's Fitness Centre' appears to be the old name of H2O - Health Hub Oasis (duplicate). Page text came through WebFetch's summarising model, so quotes may differ slightly from the live page and should be spot-checked before publishing. This region needs a follow-up round once search budget is available.
